result.instructions: Tools for Xanatek Connect, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which policies does this customer hold, and when does each one renew?"; "Show me the tasks that are due this week and who manages them."; "Create a task for our CSR to call this customer about the renewal.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Xanatek Connect data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run xanatekconnect_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run xanatekconnect_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run xanatekconnect_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. xanatekconnect_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (people and businesses) in the agency, with their name, type, status and contact details. Filter by name or active status. Connect API: GET /Customers.

change_since.description: Only records changed since this date (ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01).

tools.name: xanatekconnect_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with the primary contact, addresses, CSR, producer and customer line. Connect API: GET /Customers/{id}.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_customer_policies
tools.title: List a customer's policies
tools.description: List every policy that belongs to one customer. Connect API: GET /Customers/{id}/Policies.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_policies
tools.title: List policies
tools.description: List insurance policies with number, status, carrier, writing company, line of business, dates and premium. Filter by customer, policy number, status or active flag. Connect API: GET /Policies.

customer_id.description: Only policies of this customer id (GUID).

policy_status.description: Filter by policy status (as the Connect lookups define it).

change_since.description: Only records changed since this date (ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01).

tools.name: xanatekconnect_get_policy
tools.title: Get policy
tools.description: Get one policy by id, with its customer, carrier, writing company, status and latest policy term id. Connect API: GET /Policies/{id}.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_policy_terms
tools.title: List policy terms
tools.description: List the terms (renewal periods) of one policy, with their dates and premium. Connect API: GET /Policies/{id}/PolicyTerms.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people and companies linked to customers) with name, email, phone and status. Filter by name, email or active flag. Connect API: GET /Contacts.

change_since.description: Only records changed since this date (ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-01).

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (to-dos) with description, status, priority, due date, managing user and linked entity. Filter by status, due date, entity or managing user. Connect API: GET /Tasks.

status.description: Filter by task status (as the Connect API defines it).

due_date.description: Filter by due date (ISO date or the Connect JSON filter, e.g. {"lt":"2026-12-31"}).

entity_uid.description: Only tasks linked to this entity GUID (for example a customer).

managing_user_uid.description: Only tasks managed by this user GUID.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes attached to entities (customers, policies, contacts). Filter by the entity, or include the note body text. Connect API: GET /Note.

entity_uid.description: Only notes attached to this entity GUID (for example a customer).

include_body.description: Include the full note body text (default: false).

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the agency's users (staff accounts) with display name and active status. Connect API: GET /Users.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: List insurance carriers and brokers with name, address and active status. Connect API: GET /Carriers.

broker.description: Only brokers (true) or only non-broker carriers (false).

tools.name: xanatekconnect_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create one task (to-do) in Xanatek Connect, assigned to a user and optionally linked to a customer or policy. Creates a new record each call; it does not check for duplicates. Connect API: POST /Tasks.

user_uid.description: GUID of the user the task is assigned to (see xanatekconnect_list_users).

status.description: Task status, as the Connect API defines it (see GET /TaskStatuses).

priority.description: Task priority, as the Connect API defines it.

entity_uid.description: GUID of the entity the task is linked to (for example a customer id).

tools.name: xanatekconnect_complete_task
tools.title: Complete task
tools.description: WRITE: mark one existing task as completed. Repeating the call on a completed task does not change it again. Connect API: PUT /Tasks/CompleteTask.

task_uid.description: GUID of the task to complete (see xanatekconnect_list_tasks).

completion_date.description: Completion date-time (ISO 8601). Default: the server time.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: WRITE: attach one new note to a customer, policy or other entity. Creates a new note each call; it does not check for duplicates. Connect API: POST /Note.

entity_uid.description: GUID of the entity the note is attached to (for example a customer id).

entry_user_uid.description: GUID of the user who writes the note (see xanatekconnect_list_users).
